questions.text:
Analyse how the pacing of the text was used to build suspense or anticipation.

Write an essay on at least ONE visual or oral text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achieved (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology. Address how pacing (e.g. editing rhythm, slow motion, montage, long takes) builds suspense or anticipation. Show awareness of deliberate crafting. Include specific details. Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, showing clear understanding of how pacing choices serve the director's or creator's purpose. Weave a range of specific details. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument about how pacing creates tension and meaning, making judgments about how effects relate to the text's purpose and wider contexts.
